sendRequestWithFalsyContextVars.description:
Whether or not this {@link UiSdlComponentDataSpec} should send requests even if context vars are not resolved
to a truthy value. Overrides {@link UiSdlConfig#ignoreRequestsWithFalsyContextVars}

tunnelConfiguration.description:
When provided this will override the {@link UiSdlSite#tunnelConfiguration}.  To completely ignore any tunnel
configuration this should be explicitly set to empty object

dataTransforms.description:
List of data transform types, which will be applied after the data is
received but before saving it in the state.

Constraint: These types must extend {@link UiSdlDataTransform}.

advancedDataSpec.description:
If the developer needs to define a specific API outside of the basic functionality provided by a components
dataSpec type.  Define the {@link UiSdlComponentAdvancedDataSpec#actionName}, and optionally
{@link UiSdlComponentAdvancedDataSpec#actionArgs} required for the API.

dataType.description:
The type used to populate the data for {@link UiSdlComponent}.
Note that v8 will be last version to support a type here. We want to migrate to using only
string for type name. Using our own typeRef type allows for backwards compatibility, so both
forms "MyDataType" and { typeName: "MyDataType "} are supported.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description:
Disable if you want to avoid sending the request for this dataSpec on the first render.
Other data requests for the same component will still be sent.

ignoreFirstContextVarResolution.description:
Disable if you want to avoid sending the request for this dataSpec after the first contextVar resolves.
Other data requests for the same component will still be sent.

ignoreAllContextVarResolution.description:
Disable if you want to avoid sending the request for this dataSpec after any contextVar resolves.
Other data requests for the same component will still be sent.

dataSpecDependence.description:
Any fields that are used in toPartiallyAppliedActions to request data
but are not defined inside sub types of {@link UiSdlComponentDataSpec}

fieldsDependenceMapping.description: Mapping between fields that depend on each other. See {@link UiSdlFieldsDependenceMapping} for more.

seriesLabel.description:
A label for this event series, to be displayed at the top of the tooltip
shown when hovering over an event.

filter.description: Filter string to filter fetched events.

timestamp.description:
The field containing the timestamp value used to position this event on
the x-axis of the chart.

yValue.description:
The y-axis position at which this event series should be displayed.
If it is a Dimension value: it will display the event on a y-axis from a
metric-based series if possible. If not possible, it try to choose between
BOTTOM and TOP based on comparisons with any existing y-axes. If such a
comparison can't be done, it will fall back to BOTTOM.
To configure it in a json file, include a "type" field specifying the type
alongside other fields for the referenced type.
For example:
    "yValue": {
      "type": "UiSdlTimeseriesLineBarChartEventRelativePosition",
      "relativePosition": "BOTTOM"
    }

color.description: The default color to be shown for this data series.

tooltipAdditionalFields.description: A list of fields to be shown in the tooltip when hovering on one of these events.

symbol.description:
The symbol to use for the event marker.
{@see https://echarts.apache.org/v4/en/option.html#series-line.data.symbol}

title:
A specification for an individual event on a {@link UiSdlTimeseriesLineBarChart},
including a timestamp and various fields to be displayed in the tooltip.
name: UiSdlTimeseriesLineBarChartEventSeriesDataSpec
